profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am an innovative Software Engineer with decades of experience, and yet still passionate about learning and delivering high quality solutions.

I truly enjoy all aspects of the software lifecycle, in whatever model it presents itself to best suit the project or deadline at hand. There is always a challenge to understand what is truly needed, a chance to be creative when designing a solution, and the demand to put our skills to efficient use to deliver a quality solution that is robust, maintainable, and scalable. 

I currently specialize in windows applications written in C# with a dedicated SQL Server database, and communication to product or equipment through RS-232, CANopen, Modbus, TCP/IP, or VISA. I am responsible for the gathering of requirements, application design, database and database user(s) creation, write the technical and user documentation, and oversee the application testing.
